raw.title: Senior Analyst, Corporate Finance
raw.excerpt: Who We ArePindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era.
raw.description:
Who We Are

Pindrop is the Real Human + Right Human® Identity Trust Platform for the AI era. As AI-driven fraud and deepfakes erode trust in digital communication, Pindrop delivers continuous identity verification and deepfake detection across voice, video, and digital interactions in real time.

Enterprises rely on Pindrop to secure billions of high-risk customer interactions each year, including top U.S. banks, as well as leading insurers and healthcare providers. Powered by models trained on more than 1.5 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents, Pindrop restores trust while reducing fraud, lowering operational costs, and improving customer experience.

Recognized by TIME as one of the Top 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

What you’ll bring and do:

Pindrop is looking for a Manager of Corporate Finance to help build the next stage of our finance function—scaling planning, reporting, analytics, and decision support through stronger processes, better data, and practical AI-enabled automation. This role is ideal for someone who wants to bring investor-grade modeling, diligence-quality analysis, and crisp executive communication into an operating role where their work directly shapes how Pindrop grows, invests, and scales.

You’ll enhance the financial operating system behind Pindrop’s next stage of growth — connecting financial planning, forecasting, SaaS metrics, cash visibility, and capital allocation into clear insights for the ELT, Board, and investors. Reporting to the Director, Strategic Finance, you’ll create forward-looking insights, partner across the business and G&A, and play a central role in fundraising, M&A, IPO readiness, and investor communications as Pindrop scales. You will leverage AI-enabled workflows to automate manual reporting, improve forecast accuracy, surface performance risks faster, and help Finance scale with greater speed and precision.

We are looking for someone driven to create impact who possesses the following: 1) Analytical Horsepower for Insight Extraction 2) Interdisciplinary Collaboration and Impact 3) Reporting Automation and Data Capabilities.

Financial Architecture, Planning & Systems

  • Lead the corporate planning cadence across monthly and quarterly forecasts, AOP, MRP, LRP, and base / upside / downside scenarios, using driver-based sensitivities to pressure-test growth, burn, hiring, margin, liquidity, and financing needs for the ELT and Board
  • Build and own the company’s integrated three-statement operating model, anchored in NetSuite / GAAP actuals and driven by forward-looking assumptions for bookings, billings, revenue recognition, deferred revenue / RPO, headcount, opex, working capital, debt / interest, D&A, taxes, and equity assumptions
  • Own planning infrastructure, consolidation, and automation across the FP&A planning tool, NetSuite-to-planning actuals feed, S&M / R&D / G&A rollups, budget-owner KPIs and spend management, and AI-enabled workflows for reporting refreshes, variance commentary, forecast-risk flags, and the close-to-forecast process

SaaS Performance, Benchmarking & Value Creation

  • Own company-level SaaS metrics, executive dashboards, and performance narratives across ARR bridge, GRR / NRR, cohort retention and expansion, Rule of 40, burn multiple, Magic Number, CAC payback, LTV / CAC, gross and operating margin, cash conversion, and capital efficiency
  • Benchmark Pindrop against both public and private SaaS peer comps, identifying gaps and opportunities across growth durability, margin structure, GTM efficiency, retention, operating leverage, cash conversion, valuation drivers, and profitability progression
  • Partner with functional leaders and G&A partners to translate performance insights into concrete operating actions — headcount plans, compensation decisions, spend guardrails, productivity targets, resource allocation, forecast updates, and board-ready recommendations

Investor Readiness and Capital Strategy

  • Support investor relations, board, and corporate development workstreams, including quarterly investor updates, KPI packages, board materials, data-room preparation during fundraising (equity/debt), IPO readiness, or selective M&A or corporate development analyses as opportunities arise
  • Upgrade the cash and runway model, connecting operating forecasts to liquidity, burn, financing needs, and the path toward efficient Rule of 40-caliber growth; help evolve cash flow and working capital forecasting as the Company scales
  • Build a practical capital allocation framework to help leadership compare investment opportunities across GTM, R&D, Product, G&A, and the balance sheet, using ARR impact, payback, margin, cash burn, risk, and strategic priority to drive funding, reallocation, and stop/go decisions

Who you are

  • Possesses a growth mindset and a bias for action; enjoys creating processes and infrastructure from the ground up, not just maintain what already exists
  • Trusted advisor to the business to guide investments and strategic direction with cross-functional empathy
  • AI fluency and agentic tools (e.g., Claude) to automate the rote and multiply your output, and you want to set the standard for how a modern finance team operates
  • Self-starting, independent logical thinker comfortable operating in ambiguity to solve problems with analysis, data, and structured arguments while being an exceptional communicator who turns complex financials into crisp, investor- and board-grade narratives
  • Excited to innovate solutions and learn new tools while being agile to handle multiple projects simultaneously
  • Comfortable presenting to executive teams and aspiring to take on an active role in building a path to IPO

Your skill set

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance/Economics, Data Science, or equivalent experience, with 7-10 years of progressive finance experience, including 2+ years in investment banking or growth equity and significant corporate finance experience at a high-growth B2B SaaS or enterprise software company
  • Strong corporate finance modeling foundation required, with advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, solid GAAP and NetSuite knowledge, and the ability to translate actuals into forecasts and build scalable enterprise SaaS / usage-based models tied to revenue, margin, cash, and performance outcomes
  • Proven ownership of planning infrastructure end-to-end — including AOP, medium-/long-range planning, scenario and sensitivity analysis, FP&A/ERP systems, dashboards, and executive-ready reporting — with hands-on proficiency in AI-enabled workflows, SQL/BI tools, and reporting automation
  • Experience with board/investor reporting, capital allocation/liquidity events (strongly preferred), including IPO readiness, M&A, and private fundraising; corporate development exposure and G&A business partnering a plus

What we offer

As a part of Pindrop, you’ll have a direct impact on our growing list of products and the future of security in the voice-driven economy. We hire great people and take care of them. Here’s a snapshot of the benefits we offer:

  • Competitive compensation package, including RSUs (Restricted Stock Units) for all employees, so everyone shares in our long-term success.
  • Remote-first environment - giving you flexibility and autonomy in how you structure your day.
  • While we work flexibly, we prioritize meaningful in-person moments through regular team on-sites, company-wide events, and intentional gatherings that foster connection, collaboration, and shared success.
  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Generous health and welfare plans to choose from - including one employer-paid “employee-only” plan!
  • Best-in-class Health Savings Account (HSA) employer contribution
  • Low-cost vision and dental plans for you and your family, providing comprehensive coverage and peace of mind.
  • Paid Parental Leave - Including birth, adoptive & foster parents
    • One year of diaper delivery for your newest addition to the family! It’s our way of welcoming new Pindroplets to the family!
  • Recurring monthly phone and internet allowance to help cover essential connectivity costs and support flexible work.
  • Enhanced fertility and GLP-1 benefits to support family-building journeys and personalized health needs.
  • Annual Learning & Development stipend to support your professional growth, skill-building, certifications, and continued education.

This position will be posted for 45 days after July 24, 2026.

Remote:

Please note that the base pay range is a general guideline only. Pindrop considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, a candidate's work experience, education/training, and key skills, as well as market and business considerations, when extending an offer.

US Base Pay Range
$165,000—$180,000 USD

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team, with a broad range of experience and perspectives. If this job sounds great, but you’re not sure if you qualify, apply anyway! We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

AI - A Transformative Force

At Pindrop, we view artificial intelligence as a transformative force that, when harnessed responsibly, can unlock unprecedented value for our customers, partners and society and enable and empower us to continue to deliver cutting-edge technology to combat fraud and unblur the lines between what it means to be human versus machine.

Pindrop may use AI tools to help prioritize job applications for human review. The AI tool may analyze your work experience and skills to assess fit for the role, but does not consider your name or contact details. Applications with the strongest match to job requirements are prioritized for human review; not all applications may be individually reviewed.

Pindrop is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Here at Pindrop, it is our mission to create and maintain a diverse and inclusive work environment. As an equal opportunity employer, all qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, marital and/or veteran status.

WE ARE STARFACE

Since launching in 2019, Starface has turned the historically negative experience of having acne into a more joyful, relatable one with a category of its own: expressive and effective products that make people feel good. With a full suite of hydrocolloid pimple patches in bright colors and a roster of limited-edition collaborations— from fan-favorite characters like Hello Kitty and Snoopy to fashion brands like Marc Jacob’s Heaven—it’s easy to see why Starface users say they look forward to getting breakouts. Featuring award-winning formulas and ultra-cute packaging, Starface products are designed to make you smile every time you use them.

your impact @ starface

Starface is seeking a Controller to lead and strengthen our accounting function as we enter our next stage of growth. In this role, you’ll report directly to our SVP, Head of Finance, oversee the accounting team, and own the function across close, reporting, audits, controls, systems, external partnerships, and team development.

You’ll inherit strong building blocks, talented partners, and meaningful opportunities to improve how the work gets done. Your mandate will be to bring critical workstreams current, create more reliable and scalable processes, and build a clear roadmap for the accounting organization Starface needs as we continue to grow.

The right person for this role is an experienced, hands-on accounting leader who has successfully stepped into complex or evolving environments, created order from ambiguity, and led teams through periods of growth or transformation. You’re technically strong, comfortable rolling up your sleeves, and confident partnering with executives, auditors, advisors, and investors.

At Starface, we find fun, lead with care, aim high, stay curious, and move forward. We welcome an attitude of exploration into the bold and creative in all that we do (even accounting, if applicable and compliant!). If you are an adaptable accounting leader who sees a complicated problem and immediately starts mapping the way forward, and all of this resonates with you so far, please keep reading!

we’ll count on you to

  • Lead the full accounting function, including the monthly close, general ledger, reconciliations, financial reporting, consolidation, accounts payable, accounts receivable, inventory accounting, and technical accounting.
  • Quickly assess the current state of the function, team, systems, open workstreams, and key risks, while identifying immediate opportunities to improve accuracy, accountability, and efficiency.
  • Bring outstanding audits, covenant reporting, reconciliations, tax-related workstreams, and other critical external deliverables fully current.
  • Establish a reliable and well-controlled close process, with clear timelines, ownership, documentation, and reporting standards.
  • Lead relationships with external auditors, accountants, tax advisors, and other partners, serving as Starface’s primary accounting subject-matter expert and point of accountability.
  • Build and begin executing a practical roadmap for improving accounting processes, controls, systems, documentation, and team structure.
  • Own accounting systems and tools, including NetSuite, and partner with Operations and Systems to ensure cross-functional decisions support accurate and efficient financial processes.
  • Evaluate the accounting team’s structure, capabilities, and capacity, develop existing talent, and recommend future hiring priorities.
  • Manage and coach the accounting team, establishing clear expectations, strong operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth.
  • Partner closely with the SVP of Finance on priorities, risks, decisions, and communication with executive leadership and the Board.
  • Strengthen Starface’s readiness for future financing, investment, diligence, or M&A activity by ensuring our accounting records, controls, reporting, and documentation can withstand increased scrutiny.
  • Identify issues early, communicate them clearly, and bring forward practical recommendations and paths to resolution.
  • Balance strong controls and financial discipline with the speed and flexibility required in a fast-growing business.

this role is for you if

  • You have significant progressive accounting experience, ideally including experience as a Controller or Head of Accounting
  • You have led or materially improved an accounting function within a growing, changing, or operationally complex organization.
  • You have experience in consumer products, retail, beauty, apparel, food and beverage, or another inventory-based business.
  • You have supported a financing, investment, acquisition, sale process, or other major transaction, and understand the level of rigor, responsiveness, and documentation required.
  • You have strong knowledge of inventory accounting, revenue recognition, accruals, financial reporting, internal controls, and U.S. GAAP.
  • You have meaningful experience with NetSuite and understand how accounting systems, operational systems, and business processes intersect.
  • You have successfully led external audits and can communicate with auditors and advisors confidently and constructively.
  • You have experience working through accounting backlogs and inherited challenges that come along with a high growth, fast paced business.
  • You know how to distinguish between controls that are essential and processes that can remain appropriately lightweight.
  • You can operate strategically while staying close enough to the work to identify issues, support your team, and move priorities forward.
  • You are comfortable taking ownership quickly, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and improving existing systems rather than waiting for ideal conditions.
  • You are a strong people leader who can assess talent, develop team members, and thoughtfully build an accounting organization for the future.
  • You communicate proactively and know how to keep senior leadership informed of progress, risks, tradeoffs, and recommended next steps.
  • You are collaborative, low-ego, and able to build trust across Finance, Operations, Systems, and the broader organization.
  • You are located in the Eastern or Central time zone, or can maintain substantial working-hour overlap with teams and partners across the U.S. and U.K.
  • A CPA and private equity backed company experience are strongly preferred

salary & benefits

  • The compensation range for this role is a $190,000-$230,000 base depending on level of experience, as well as bonus eligibility.
  • Additional benefits include:
    • Access to high-quality health care options
    • Access to a 401k with 5% employer match eligibility
    • 4 weeks of vacation plus up to 20 paid holidays
    • 12 weeks fully paid parental leave
    • 5 days of pet-ernity leave for pet adoption
    • Home office & internet supplement stipend

    • Flexible Fridays, and Summer Fridays

    • ...and much, much more!

You’ll be at the heart of Weka’s marketing evolution, breaking down silos, streamlining operations, and driving key initiatives across the company. This is an opportunity to make a tangible impact, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and bring creative solutions to complex challenges—all within a high-growth company redefining what's possible in AI. The Director, Marketing Operations and Analytics is responsible for overseeing the operational aspects of a marketing function, leveraging data analysis to drive strategic decision-making. Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)

Salary Range: $100,000–$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking a Big Data Architect to define and lead the architecture of our enterprise data platform, spanning ingestion, storage, processing, governance, and consumption layers. The role drives the strategic direction of data infrastructure, sets standards for data modeling and lifecycle management, and partners with data engineering, analytics, ML, and business stakeholders to deliver a coherent, scalable data foundation. The ideal candidate combines deep technical mastery of modern data platforms with strong architectural judgment, and has led data-platform programs of meaningful scope and complexity.

Key Responsibilities
  • Define the target-state architecture of the enterprise data platform, including ingestion, storage, processing, and consumption layers.
  • Establish standards for data modeling, schema evolution, partitioning, file formats, and storage organization.
  • Architect lakehouse, warehouse, and streaming patterns leveraging technologies such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, Redshift, Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi.
  • Design end-to-end data pipelines that balance latency, cost, reliability, and maintainability across batch and streaming workloads.
  • Lead the integration of governance, lineage, and catalog tools such as Collibra, Alation, Atlan, Unity Catalog, or DataHub.
  • Define security architecture including row- and column-level controls, masking, encryption, and identity-aware access patterns.
  • Partner with ML, BI, and product teams to ensure platform capabilities align with downstream consumption needs.
  • Establish data contract and data product principles to drive ownership, quality, and decoupling between producers and consumers.
  • Lead architecture reviews and provide guidance on pipeline and warehouse design proposals across teams.
  • Drive cost optimization and capacity planning across the data platform estate.
  • Design disaster recovery, multi-region, and high-availability strategies for critical data assets.
  • Mentor data engineers and architects on platform standards and emerging best practices.
  • Produce architecture artifacts including context diagrams, decision records, and reference patterns.
  • Stay current with data platform research, vendor offerings, and open-source ecosystem developments.
Required Qualifications
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • Eight or more years of experience in data engineering, with significant time in architecture roles.
  • Deep expertise across at least two major data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or Redshift.
  • Strong understanding of lakehouse architectures, modern table formats, and streaming systems.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark, Flink, or Kafka at production scale.
  • Strong data modeling expertise across dimensional, normalized, and data-vault patterns.
  • Experience implementing governance, lineage, and catalog capabilities.
  • Solid grasp of cloud platforms, networking, identity, and cost optimization.
  • Excellent communication, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Track record of leading large data platform initiatives across teams.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience with data mesh or data product architectures.
  • Familiarity with semantic layers such as dbt Semantic Layer, Cube, or LookML.
  • Exposure to regulated industries with strict data residency or audit requirements.
  • Cloud or platform certifications (Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Azure, GCP).
  • Public talks or writing on data architecture.

About Us

Solar Landscape is the leading commercial rooftop solar developer in the U.S. Only 4% of commercial rooftops host solar today — we’re changing that, fast. Commercial rooftop solar is the fastest, smartest way to build new clean power — delivering megawatts of generation in months, not years, and powering America’s energy and future right where it’s needed most. By turning rooftops into local power plants, we’re reshaping how — and how fast — energy gets built in the U.S.
Recognized as the #1 Distributed Generation Developer by New Project Media, the #1 National Commercial Rooftop Solar Developer by Solar Power World, and winner of the U.S. Department of Energy’s Grand Prize for Clean Energy, Solar Landscape is defining the future of energy generation in America.
Headquartered in Asbury Park, New Jersey, Solar Landscape has offices in Chicago, Baltimore, and New York City and operates in over a dozen states nationwide.
We move fast, solve hard problems, and take our work seriously — but never ourselves. We value clear thinking, accountability, and execution. At the same time, we’re collaborative by default, and believe the best work happens when people enjoy working together. Our team is made up of smart, grounded people who show up for each other — whether that’s troubleshooting a system design or catching up over lunch.
If you’re looking to do meaningful work in a high-performance environment — and be part of the team reshaping how energy gets built in the U.S. — we’d love to meet you.

About The Role

Solar Landscape is seeking a highly skilled and agile Associate General Counsel – General Corporate/Finance attorney to join our legal team. This role is ideal for a proactive legal professional who thrives in a collaborative environment and enjoys working across multiple facets of corporate law, project finance, and project development. The Associate General Counsel – General Corporate attorney will play a key role in handling general corporate legal matters, including entity formation and ongoing corporate compliance, project financing, and subscriber acquisition and management.
The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in corporate law, specifically within the renewable energy sector, and will be responsible for drafting and negotiating key agreements and filings necessary for Solar Landscape’s business operations.

Responsibilities

  • General Corporate & Transactional Legal Support:
  • Provide legal support for project financing and renewable energy certificates (RECs) transactions.
  • Handle entity formation and registration, and ensure compliance with various state and federal filings, including FERC.
  • Manage subscriber acquisition and related legal documentation.
  • Draft, review, and negotiate NDAs.
  • Project Finance & Project Development:

  • Identify and resolve title and survey issues impacting solar project sites.
  • Collaborate with non-legal business teams during a solar project’s life cycle, from development through construction, finance, and energization.
  • Regulatory Compliance & Risk Management:
  • Ensure compliance with applicable laws and regulations related to real estate and renewable energy development.
  • Stay informed of evolving legal trends and regulatory changes impacting solar projects.
  • Assist in researching and advising on novel issues in new markets, including policy and business development considerations.
  • Strategic Legal Advisory:
  • Partner with the Business Development team to structure and close deals efficiently.
  • Act as a trusted legal advisor to leadership, offering strategic insights on corporate governance, project-specific considerations, and risk mitigation strategies.
  • Provide expert legal analysis and solutions to support company-wide operations.

Qualifications

  • Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an accredited law school and active bar membership in good standing.
  • 1+ years of relevant legal experience in corporate law, including project finance and/or M&A, (experience within the renewable energy sector is ideal, but not required).
  • Strong experience in contract negotiation and corporate regulatory compliance.
  • Ability to balance business expectations with legal and regulatory compliance objectives efficiently.
  • Excellent analytical, communication, presentation, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • This position is fully remote but offers the option to work from the headquarters in Asbury Park, NJ.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Operations Specialist to join our Operations team — someone with both a high IQ and a high EQ who thrives on getting to the bottom of complex problems. This role sits behind the frontline support team, handling escalated issues that require deeper investigation into our systems and data. You'll spend your days querying databases, tracing transactions across payment platforms, and using AI tooling like Claude to diagnose root causes and resolve issues that others can't. It's a great fit for a curious, technically-minded problem solver who wants to grow at the intersection of operations, data, and engineering within a fast-paced, rapidly growing team.

What You'll Do:

  • Serve as the escalation point for complex issues handed up from frontline support, owning them from investigation through resolution
  • Write and run SQL queries to investigate transaction discrepancies, refund and payment issues, reconciliation gaps, and other data-related problems
  • Use Claude and other AI tools to investigate issues, analyze logs, draft queries, and accelerate root-cause analysis
  • Trace issues across payment and support systems (e.g., card processors, ledgers, help-desk platforms) to identify where and why something went wrong
  • Reproduce, diagnose, and document root causes, then either resolve the issue directly or clearly hand off a well-scoped bug report to Engineering
  • Write clear, concise documentation, runbooks, and internal knowledge-base articles so recurring issues can be resolved faster
  • Partner closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations to escalate patterns, file detailed tickets, and follow issues through to a fix
  • Act as an advocate for both customers and frontline agents, surfacing trends and recommending improvements to our products, tooling, and processes

What We Look for:

  • Hands-on SQL skills — comfortable writing queries with joins, filtering, and aggregation to investigate data independently (query optimization experience a plus)
  • Comfort using AI tools like Claude as part of a technical investigation workflow, with sound judgment about when to trust and how to verify their output
  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting instincts; you're driven to dig into the details of a system or process until you find the real cause
  • 3+ years of technical support, operations, or a related problem-solving role, ideally in software, fintech, or payments
  • Experience handling escalated, complex issues — troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and problem resolution rather than scripted responses
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical findings clearly to both non-technical and engineering audiences
  • Able to manage multiple investigations at once and use personal judgment to prioritize and take initiative
  • Fluent in written and spoken English
  • A passion for what you do, paired with strong personal and corporate integrity, and genuine excitement to learn new technologies
  • Experience with Zendesk, Jira, Grafana/Loki, or similar support and observability tooling is a strong plus
  • Familiarity with payment systems, card processors, or ledger/reconciliation concepts is a plus

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome:

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators. We believe in surrounding ourselves with only the best and the brightest individuals. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth, we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We can make that happen. Basically, what we are saying is that whatever outpatient care you are interested in providing, we can surely accommodate you. We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

We prioritize the clinician's experience by offering excellent compensation, benefits, training/supervision, and flexibility. Whether you’re working from home or in one of our physical offices, if you’re doing it during your scheduled work hours, you’re getting paid for it. Our compensation packages include:

  • Starting Salary range: $70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year.
  • 401K with maximum employee matching.
  • Health care benefits.
  • Generous paid vacation and sick leave time.
  • Paid administrative time for consultation, supervision, and documentation.
  • Full administrative support.

Here are a few extra perks our team loves:

  • Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.
  • Customized schedules within available clinic hours.
  • Hybrid work environment if desired: Telehealth and/or in-person (in select locations).
  • Muti-disciplinary team approach to treatment.
  • Incredible administrative support team.
  • Company leadership that understands the practice of mental healthcare.
  • Inclusive, socially responsible, client focused leadership.
  • We are not a franchise or a big investor-backed company.
  • And most importantly, clinician-led and clinician-FOCUSED!

We know what it’s like to work in an organization led by businesspeople instead of clinicians. We, on the other hand, have organically grown as a socially responsible company that started as a single provider on a mission to destigmatize and broaden the reach of mental health care, to an integrated and holistic group of exceptional providers with diverse backgrounds working toward that mission. We are fortunate to have significantly increased the reach of mental health care services in our communities, and look forward to continuing to provide consistent, high-quality care to those we serve for many years to come.

We will rely on your expertise to:

  • Evaluate mental health conditions, diagnose, create, and implement a treatment plan, complete ongoing documentation including further diagnosis, treatment plan reviews, and case notes according to company policy.
  • Provide excellent care for clients and collaborate with a dynamic team to further the mission of filling gaps in our community.
  • Utilize creativity in interventions to help clients achieve and exceed goals.
  • Prepare and submit individual documentation for each session per company guidelines and protocol. 
  • For Full-Time status, clinicians must maintain at least 32 available hours for patient care per week.
  • Coordinate services with other care providers, families, work personnel, medical personnel, other OptiMindHealth staff, and school staff as needed.
  • Attend and participate in all clinical staff meetings and trainings.

Qualifications and Skill for This Positions: 

  • Master's degree in one of the behavioral sciences or related fields from an accredited college/university.
  • Full, current, unrestricted license to practice independently (LMHC, LCSW, LMFT) is required.
  • Experience with electronic health records and completing clinical documentation.
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience and willingness to work collaboratively and creatively to meet necessary deadlines.
  • Comfort and familiarity working with clients with a diverse range of problems or concerns. 
  • Ability to pass a background check in a way that confirms to us you can provide safe care.  
  • Demonstrate and model stable and appropriate boundaries with clients.

Additionally Valuable (but not essential) Qualifications for This Position: 

  • Experience working in community, group, or private practice mental health.
  • Currently paneled or credentialed with insurance network.
  • Multilingual or bilingual proficiency.
  • Specialty area of practice. 

We can’t wait to hear your story and look forward to sharing ours!

The specific statements shown in each section of this Job Description are not intended to be all-inclusive. They represent typical elements and criteria considered necessary to perform the job successfully. The job’s responsibilities/tasks may be modified and/or expanded over time. OMH will inform the employee when changes in the respective job description are made.

Salary: $70,000 – $85,000 / year

This isn't about maintaining an existing product. You'll own one of the company's biggest strategic initiatives, taking Embedded Accounting from its current stage through launch, growth and international expansion.

If you're the kind of Product Owner who loves shipping products, speaking to customers and seeing your work make a tangible commercial impact, we'd love to hear from you.

The Opportunity

You'll become the product owner for our Embedded Accounting platform, working alongside engineering, design, commercial teams and senior leadership to define what gets built next.

You'll own the roadmap, prioritise features, gather customer insight and ensure the team delivers high-quality releases that customers genuinely love.

Success in this role isn't measured by documents written.

It's measured by products launched, customers adopting them and revenue generated.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the Embedded Accounting product roadmap from idea through delivery
  • Prioritise features that solve real customer problems
  • Work closely with engineering to ship valuable releases quickly

You'll Thrive Here If You...

  • Love owning products end-to-end
  • Enjoy speaking directly with customers
  • Can balance commercial thinking with user experience

What We're Looking For

Essential

You'll be joining a product team investing heavily in embedded financial services, building technology that simplifies accounting for thousands of growing businesses.

If you enjoy building products from the ground up and seeing customers adopt what you've shipped, you'll find plenty of opportunity here.

raw.excerpt: Real people.  Real service. At SupplyHouse. com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first.
raw.description:
Real people. Real service.

At SupplyHouse.com, we value every individual team member and cultivate a community where people come first. Led by our core values of Generosity, Respect, Innovation, Teamwork, and GRIT, we’re dedicated to maintaining a supportive work environment that celebrates diversity and empowers everyone to reach their full potential. As an industry-leading e-commerce company specializing in HVAC, plumbing, heating, and electrical supplies since 2004, we strive to foster growth while providing the best possible experience for our customers.

We are looking for a Marketplace Operations Manager to join our Product Team. This individual will report into our Senior Manager, Category Management and will be responsible for the day-to-day operational health of SupplyHouse’s third-party marketplace channel. This role ensures that marketplace performance is continuously monitored, supplier onboarding is executed efficiently, and catalog and listing quality standards are upheld. If you are interested in finding and onboarding new marketplace suppliers and building a pipeline of qualified partners, we want to hear from you!

This remote position is open to individuals who live in, or are open to relocating to, the following states: Arizona, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Kentucky, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Tennessee, Texas, Virginia, and Washington.

This position requires travel to our headquarters in Melville, NY 3 times per year for internal meetings and team building activities. We reimburse reasonable and necessary travel expenses, and you’re also welcome to work on-site anytime beyond these visits – our doors are always open.

Role Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Location: Remote

Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. with time zone flexibility

Base Salary: $92,940 – $116,175 per year

Responsibilities:

  • Proactively research and identify new marketplace supplier candidates across target categories, using competitive analysis, industry resources, and internal category gaps as inputs
  • Conduct initial outreach to prospective suppliers, articulate SupplyHouse’s marketplace value proposition, and manage the early-stage relationship through qualification
  • Coordinate with Category Management to prioritize and schedule new supplier conversations, ensuring alignment with category strategy before advancing candidates
  • Own the end-to-end onboarding process for approved suppliers, including agreement coordination, contract administration, data requirements communication, and timeline management
  • Lead technical feed setup and validation for new suppliers—mapping product data, verifying feed accuracy, and resolving data quality issues prior to go-live
  • Train new suppliers on SupplyHouse’s systems, data standards, and operational requirements, ensuring they are set up for long-term success on the platform
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for new suppliers through the onboarding period, troubleshooting issues and maintaining momentum to hit go-live milestones
  • Document onboarding processes and maintain SOPs to ensure consistent, repeatable execution as the supplier base grows
  • Develop and maintain claims, warranty, and returns processes for marketplace suppliers, ensuring clear guidelines and consistent execution across the supplier base
  • Monitor post-launch supplier performance and flag issues with service levels, data quality, or accounting discrepancies for resolution
  • Review weekly feeds for new item suggestions and coordinate with Category Management on additions
  • Research competitor listings to identify opportunities for improvement in content, imagery, and positioning
  • Conduct image audits and data cleanup including attribute and filter updates on new brand
  • Own SOP creation and ongoing maintenance for marketplace operational workflows
  • Test and document new marketplace features and platform capabilities within the supplier dashboards
  • Execute ad hoc operational projects including data cleanup, content audits, and cross-system reconciliation
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Merchandising, Pricing, and Supply Chain teams to resolve issues and support execution
  • Respond to basic marketplace customer inquiries escalated from Customer Service or order fulfillment, and review processed returns to identify trends
  • Reconcile discrepancies between freight and non-freight shipping methods and partner with Product Catalog to update item dimensions as needed
  • Monitor out-of-stock items and communicate gaps to the Merchandising team; support price update processes to maintain alignment between SupplyHouse and supplier pricing

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree in in Business, Marketing, Merchandising, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • A minimum of 5 years of experience in marketplace operations, e-commerce merchandising, or a related field
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and inventory data and translate findings into action
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and comfort working across multiple data systems and reporting tools
  • Experience managing supplier or vendor relationships in an operational capacity
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams and shifting priorities
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate across cross-functional teams
  • Proven ability to document processes and create SOPs in a structured, repeatable format

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with marketplace platforms (e.g., Amazon, Home Depot, Walmart, or similar) or B2B e-commerce environments
  • Familiarity with product feed management, catalog systems, or MDM tools
  • Experience in plumbing, HVAC, or trade supply distribution is a plus

Why work with us:

  • We have awesome benefits – We offer a wide variety of benefits to help support you and your loved ones. These include:
    • Comprehensive and affordable medical, dental, vision, and voluntary life insurance options
    • 401(k) with up to 4% company match
    • Paid vacation, sick time, and holidays
    • Company-paid basic life insurance and long-term disability
    • Discounted auto, home, and pet insurance programs
    • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
    • Confidential mental health, financial planning, and legal support through our Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
    • Company-provided equipment and one-time $250 work from home stipend
    • $750 annual professional development budget
    • $25 monthly Grubhub credit
    • Company rewards and recognition program
    • And more!
  • We empower ownership – We all contribute to our success and we all share in it. Our Ownership for All program ensures each SupplyHouse team member will benefit financially from the company’s growth and accomplishments.
  • We promote work-life balance –We value your time and encourage a healthy separation between your professional and personal life to feel refreshed and recharged. Look out for our wellness initiatives and ask about our Flex-Time Policy!
  • We support growth –We encourage you to embrace continuous learning and take on new challenges. In an exciting and evolving industry, we provide opportunities for career growth through our annual merit and bonus opportunities, hands-on training, diversity and inclusion initiatives, internal mobility options, and professional development budget.
  • We give back – We live and breathe our core value, Generosity, by giving back to the trades and organizations around the world. We make a difference through donation drives, employee-nominated contributions, support for non-profit organizations, Volunteer Paid Time Off, and more.
  • We listen – We value hearing from our employees. Everyone has a voice, and we encourage you to use it! We actively elicit feedback through our monthly town halls, regular 1:1 check-ins, employee listening initiatives, and company-wide ideas form to incorporate suggestions and ensure our team enjoys coming to work every day.

Check us out and learn more at: https://www.supplyhouse.com/our-company!

Additional Details:

  • Remote employees are expected to work in a distraction-free environment. Personal devices, background noise, and other distractions should be kept to a minimum to avoid disrupting virtual meetings or business operations.
  • Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the U.S. on a full-time basis. SupplyHouse.com will not sponsor applicants for work visas.
  • SupplyHouse.com is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome and encourage individuals of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to apply. Employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business needs.
  • To ensure fairness and trust in our hiring process, we ask that all application materials, assessments, and interview responses reflect your own thinking and perspective. You may use AI tools to assist in preparing your responses, as long as this use is clearly disclosed and you can speak authentically to your ideas and work. Our focus is on honesty, judgment, and how you approach problem-solving. We appreciate your transparency and look forward to learning more about your skills.
  • We are committed to providing a safe and secure work environment and conduct thorough background checks on all potential employees in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.
  • All emails from the SupplyHouse team will only be sent from an @supplyhouse.com email address. Please exercise caution if you receive an email from an alternate domain.

raw.description:
Intradiem is reinventing customer service for everyone by helping organizations connect people, technology, and real-time action to create more agile operations and more human experiences.

Who We Are
Intradiem is the leader in Dynamic Workforce Orchestration. We help organizations create service agility by connecting people, technology, and real-time data to improve customer experiences and support employees. We believe automation should empower humans, not replace them.

What We Do
Our platform turns real-time insights into real-time action. By orchestrating work across customer service teams, we help organizations break down silos, adapt instantly to changing demand, and operate more efficiently without losing the human touch which is essential to customer service.

How We Work
We solve real operational problems alongside our customers. Our approach is practical, collaborative, and focused on outcomes. We listen first, build with purpose, and create technology solutions that work in the real world.

Our Culture
We’re proud to be a people-first company. We treat employees with trust, respect, and flexibility because great customer experiences start with supported teams. We move fast, collaborate closely, and believe the best ideas come from empowered people working together.

Our Values

We encourage our employees to contribute time and energy to causes that help improve the people and communities in which they live and work. We are guided by three core values:

Servant's Heart—We believe in caring enough about other people to understand what their problems are and placing the needs of colleagues, customers, and others over personal objectives.

Craftsman's Attitude—We believe in taking pride in the work we do and creating solutions that actually solve the problem at hand (and trying again if the first attempt doesn't do the trick).

Growth Mindset—We believe that progress comes from curiosity, openness, and perseverance. We welcome feedback, embrace change, and push beyond comfort zones to unlock new potential for ourselves, our teams, and our customers.

Enterprise Data Architecture & Execution

  • Execute Intradiem's enterprise data strategy and roadmap, ensuring data architecture supports AI transformation and advanced analytics capabilities.
  • Implement and maintain comprehensive data governance frameworks covering data quality, lineage, access controls, privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements.
  • Support defining enterprise data standards, cataloging, metadata management, and self-service analytics capabilities that democratize data access while maintaining security.
  • Partner with IT and Legal teams on data privacy frameworks, security architecture, and regulatory compliance.

Business Intelligence & Analytics Execution

  • Support the buildout and maintenance of business intelligence solutions that drive data-driven decision making across all functions with production-grade reliability and monitoring.
  • Build automated reporting systems and KPI tracking mechanisms with real-time monitoring capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical data solutions and reporting frameworks.
  • Troubleshoot data quality issues and implement systematic solutions to ensure data integrity and reliability.
  • Serve as primary point of contact with our data infrastructure partners, managing relationships and technical requirements.

AI-Ready Data Infrastructure

  • Lead and coordinate the transformation of enterprise data architecture to be AI-native, ensuring data is structured, accessible, and optimized, partnering with and enabling the AI Center of Excellence rather than executing in isolation.
  • Establish API frameworks and data integration patterns that enable real-time AI model access to enterprise data.
  • Create data sandboxes and experimentation environments for AI use case development and testing.
  • Build automated data quality monitoring and anomaly detection systems.

SharePoint (Intraverse) Platform Ownership

  • Serve as primary administrator and strategic owner of Intradiem's complete SharePoint environment, including all sites, permissions, workflows, governance structures, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Drive platform adoption through training programs, best practices documentation, user enablement initiatives, and content governance policies.
  • Optimize platform performance, implement security protocols, and ensure disaster recovery capabilities while managing information architecture that scales with organizational growth.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Work closely with IT and Security teams on data architecture, access controls, and compliance monitoring.
  • Establish data stewardship programs and train business users on data literacy and responsible data usage.
  • Lead data governance committee and establish policies for data sharing, retention, and lifecycle management.
  • Conduct all business in accordance with Intradiem's policies and procedures.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Your Background:

Technical Leadership

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 7+ years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or data architecture roles, preferably in SaaS/enterprise software environments.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, warehousing concepts, and modern data architecture principles.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI and similar platforms) and partnering with external vendors.
  • Working knowledge of databases, data integration platforms, and enterprise system connectivity.

AI & Data Architecture

  • Design enterprise AI governance frameworks and evaluate ML/AI platform integrations
  • Architect modern data pipelines and infrastructure to support AI initiatives
  • Lead cross-functional AI readiness assessments and capability development

SharePoint Administration

  • Administer SharePoint Online environments, permissions, and business process workflows
  • Manage SharePoint integrations with Microsoft 365 ecosystem and coordinate updates
  • Provide SharePoint training, support, and governance, as needed, to users and site administrators

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and executive-level communications.
  • Experience leading cross-functional data initiatives and driving organizational change around a data-driven culture.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution when needed.

Work Authorization:Candidates must have the legal right to work in the country where the role is based at the time of application. Verification of identity and employment eligibility will be required during onboarding.

Intradiem is an equal-opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

Job Title: SeniorData Engineer

Location: Remote (U.S Required)

Work Authorization: Allowed to work where they live

Organizational Level: Senior Software Engineer I

Salary Range: $145,000-$200,000

About the Role

OpenTeams is hiring for a Senior Data Engineer to maintain and improve core data infrastructure for a key client account. In this role, you will architect and implement the critical data foundations required to fuel advanced analytics and AI initiatives. Your primary focus involves hands-on development in SQL and Python within modern cloud environments, and you will be instrumental in creating high-performance generation pipelines for product models that deliver significant enterprise value.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and build of ETL processes in collaboration with software and model development teams.
  • Create and maintain scalable data infrastructure.
  • Own full pipeline and infrastructure lifecycle including performance monitoring and optimization.
  • Maintain and improve existing pipelines, ensuring stability over existing requirements and adapting to new needs.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Expert proficiency in SQL for heavy utilization in building data assets and complex pipelines.
  • Full proficiency in Python for data processing tasks and pipeline integration.
  • Experience manipulating, aggregating, and expanding large-scale data assets.
  • Proven experience with cloud solutions, specifically Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with MLOps, including model deployment and monitoring.
  • Familiarity with ETL pipeline orchestration tools like Apache Airflow.
  • Experience working in direct collaboration with downstream data consumers responsible for feature engineering, training, and monitoring of deep-learning models.
  • Experience working in a remote environment, collaborating with hybrid teams

We believe the best careers are built at the edge of your potential. That is where new tools, ideas, and technologies change the world. As your skills grow, our career framework provides a pathway and recognition of that increased impact.

Opportunities aren’t limited by geography. You’ll collaborate with global experts, contribute to open source projects that power the world’s technology, and stretch your skills daily. That global perspective and diversity makes our solution more universal and robust. We are committed to continuing to celebrate diversity on our team.

Supported people are successful people. We offer 100% employer paid medical premiums for employees and self-managed PTO with a minimum time off requirement, so that our teams are able to do their best work.

We invest in curiosity, creativity, and ownership. That means you’ll be trusted to boldly innovate, supported to learn fast, and celebrated for successful collaboration.

Commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging

OpenTeams understands that valuing diverse creative practices and forms of knowledge is crucial to and enriches the company’s core mission. We encourage applications from everyone, including members of all equity-seeking communities, such as (but certainly not limited to) women, racialized and Indigenous persons, disabled people, persons of all sexual orientations, gender identities and expressions.

Who We Are
Intradiem is the leader in Dynamic Workforce Orchestration. We help organizations create service agility by connecting people, technology, and real-time data to improve customer experiences and support employees. We believe automation should empower humans, not replace them.

What We Do
Our platform turns real-time insights into real-time action. By orchestrating work across customer service teams, we help organizations break down silos, adapt instantly to changing demand, and operate more efficiently without losing the human touch which is essential to customer service.

How We Work
We solve real operational problems alongside our customers. Our approach is practical, collaborative, and focused on outcomes. We listen first, build with purpose, and create technology solutions that work in the real world.

Our Culture
We’re proud to be a people-first company. We treat employees with trust, respect, and flexibility because great customer experiences start with supported teams. We move fast, collaborate closely, and believe the best ideas come from empowered people working together.

Our Values

We encourage our employees to contribute time and energy to causes that help improve the people and communities in which they live and work. We are guided by three core values:

Servant's Heart—We believe in caring enough about other people to understand what their problems are and placing the needs of colleagues, customers, and others over personal objectives.

Craftsman's Attitude—We believe in taking pride in the work we do and creating solutions that actually solve the problem at hand (and trying again if the first attempt doesn't do the trick).

Growth Mindset—We believe that progress comes from curiosity, openness, and perseverance. We welcome feedback, embrace change, and push beyond comfort zones to unlock new potential for ourselves, our teams, and our customers.

Enterprise Data Architecture & Execution

  • Execute Intradiem's enterprise data strategy and roadmap, ensuring data architecture supports AI transformation and advanced analytics capabilities.
  • Implement and maintain comprehensive data governance frameworks covering data quality, lineage, access controls, privacy, and regulatory compliance requirements.

  • Partner with IT and Legal teams on data privacy frameworks, security architecture, and regulatory compliance.

Business Intelligence & Analytics Execution

  • Support the buildout and maintenance of business intelligence solutions that drive data-driven decision making across all functions with production-grade reliability and monitoring.
  • Build automated reporting systems and KPI tracking mechanisms with real-time monitoring capabilities.
  • Collaborate with business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical data solutions and reporting frameworks.
  • Troubleshoot data quality issues and implement systematic solutions to ensure data integrity and reliability.
  • Serve as primary point of contact with our data infrastructure partners, managing relationships and technical requirements.

AI-Ready Data Infrastructure

  • Lead and coordinate the transformation of enterprise data architecture to be AI-native, ensuring data is structured, accessible, and optimized, partnering with and enabling the AI Center of Excellence rather than executing in isolation.
  • Establish API frameworks and data integration patterns that enable real-time AI model access to enterprise data.
  • Create data sandboxes and experimentation environments for AI use case development and testing.
  • Build automated data quality monitoring and anomaly detection systems.

SharePoint (Intraverse) Platform Ownership

  • Serve as primary administrator and strategic owner of Intradiem's complete SharePoint environment, including all sites, permissions, workflows, governance structures, and integration with enterprise systems.
  • Drive platform adoption through training programs, best practices documentation, user enablement initiatives, and content governance policies.
  • Optimize platform performance, implement security protocols, and ensure disaster recovery capabilities while managing information architecture that scales with organizational growth.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Governance

  • Work closely with IT and Security teams on data architecture, access controls, and compliance monitoring.
  • Establish data stewardship programs and train business users on data literacy and responsible data usage.
  • Lead data governance committee and establish policies for data sharing, retention, and lifecycle management.
  • Conduct all business in accordance with Intradiem's policies and procedures.
  • Perform all other duties as assigned.

Your Background:

Technical Leadership

  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 7+ years of experience in data management, business intelligence, or data architecture roles, preferably in SaaS/enterprise software environments.
  • Strong understanding of data modeling, warehousing concepts, and modern data architecture principles.
  • Experience with business intelligence tools (Power BI and similar platforms) and partnering with external vendors.
  • Working knowledge of databases, data integration platforms, and enterprise system connectivity.

AI & Data Architecture

  • Design enterprise AI governance frameworks and evaluate ML/AI platform integrations
  • Architect modern data pipelines and infrastructure to support AI initiatives
  • Lead cross-functional AI readiness assessments and capability development

SharePoint Administration

  • Administer SharePoint Online environments, permissions, and business process workflows
  • Manage SharePoint integrations with Microsoft 365 ecosystem and coordinate updates
  • Provide SharePoint training, support, and governance, as needed, to users and site administrators

Leadership & Communication

  • Proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into business value and executive-level communications.
  • Experience leading cross-functional data initiatives and driving organizational change around a data-driven culture.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to balance strategic vision with hands-on execution when needed.

At COLIBRIX ONE*, we’re building advanced, AI-powered payment technologies that support Payment Service Providers (PSPs), Electronic Money Institutions (EMIs), and neobanks across the EU and the UK. As a fully licensed Electronic Money Institution (FCA Reference No. 927920) and holder of a Financial Institution Licence issued by the MFSA, as well as a principal member of both VISA and Mastercard, we provide comprehensive, real-world financial solutions that include:

  • Global card processing
  • Digital wallet infrastructure
  • Cross-border merchant accounts
  • Alternative payment methods (APMs)
  • Corporate accounts for legal entities

We’re a fast-growing team with a passion for innovation, security, and scalability. Our culture values curiosity, collaboration, and impact - and we’re looking for talented professionals who are ready to shape the future of fintech.

At COLIBRIX ONE, your work directly powers the digital economy. If you're eager to solve meaningful challenges and build with purpose, we’d love to hear from you.

About the Role

We're looking for a Transaction Monitoring Specialist with strong analytical skills to detect fraud, assess risk, and ensure compliance with AML/CTF regulations and card scheme rules. You will monitor transactions in real time, investigate suspicious activity, and support improvements in monitoring processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Monitor deposits and review daily fraud reports to ensure merchant compliance with Visa and Mastercard programs
  • Conduct real-time transaction monitoring for both business and individual clients
  • Analyze large volumes of transaction data to detect suspicious patterns and potential fraud
  • Perform periodic evaluations of client accounts and website functionality, including test transactions, to ensure compliance
  • Investigate merchants and portfolios to assess risk, ensure compliance, and detect fraudulent or illegal activities
  • Identify potential money laundering, terrorist financing, and sanctions evasion scenarios
  • Collect and manage additional client data related to completed transactions
  • Address operational monitoring issues promptly, escalating and reporting suspicious activities as needed
  • Ensure all client transactions comply with AML/CTF procedures and guidelines
  • Assist colleagues from other departments with AML/CTF-related matters
  • Provide insights and recommendations to enhance transaction monitoring efficiency

What you need to succeed in this role

  • Minimum of 2 years of experience in AML
  • Strong understanding of AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices
  • Familiarity with customer due diligence (CDD) and enhanced due diligence (EDD) procedures
  • Familiarity with payment screening processes
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with strong attention to detail
  • Ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and AML software/tools
  • Certification in AML/CTF or a related field is a plus
  • Experience working in a fast-paced environment
  • Motivation to learn and contribute to ongoing process improvements
  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly
  • Fluency in English (additional languages are considered an asset)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to shape the future of fintech solutions within a growing company
  • Collaborative, horizontal team structure that values your expertise and ideas
  • Continuous learning and development opportunities to enhance your skills and career growth
  • Competitive salary and benefits package

* This position is offered within the COLIBRIX ONE. Employment will be under the appropriate legal entity based on the role and location.

Description

About the Role

The Salesforce Administrator owns and optimizes our Salesforce platform — a mature, heavily automated environment spanning Sales Cloud and Service Cloud. You will manage significant custom configuration, a body of existing legacy automation, and numerous critical integrations (NetSuite, marketing automation, e-signature, telephony, and more).

This is a hands-on role for a skilled administrator who can configure declaratively, keep our integration ecosystem healthy, and translate cross-functional business needs into reliable, scalable solutions. We actively manage and extend this org using AI-assisted tooling (including Claude Code), so we are especially interested in someone who already leverages AI to streamline administration or is genuinely driven to work in an AI-forward setup.

Key Responsibilities

System Administration & Security

  • Serve as the primary system administrator for Sales Cloud and Service Cloud.
  • Manage user lifecycle, roles, profiles, permission sets, field-level security, and sharing rules.
  • Support end users with troubleshooting, training, and documentation to drive adoption across departments.

Automation & Process Modernization

  • Design, build, and maintain complex declarative automation using Salesforce Flow (record-triggered, screen, scheduled, and HTTP callout flows).
  • Audit, rationalize, and retire legacy Workflow Rules and Process Builders into clean, maintainable Flows.
  • Administer Service Cloud processes, including Case assignment rules, queue management, and automated offboarding cases tied to client cancellations.

Integrations & Ecosystem Management

  • Own and maintain integrations across connected platforms, including NetSuite (via Celigo / integrator.io), GoHighLevel, PDF Butler (e-signature/doc-gen), Dialpad, Apollo, HubSpot (sunset phase), and Outlook/Teams sync.
  • Configure and support custom API- and webhook-based integrations to ensure uninterrupted data flow across systems.

Deployments, Data Hygiene & Analytics

  • Manage deployments across sandboxes and production using the Metadata API, Salesforce CLI, or Change Sets, troubleshooting test-coverage and deployment failures.
  • Build and maintain reports and dashboards supporting pipeline, subscription-revenue metrics (MRR, ARR, churn), and operational decision-making.
  • Ensure data hygiene through validation rules, deduplication, and regular audits (e.g., lead-source completeness, duplicate resolution).

AI & Innovation

  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT) to accelerate Flow design, formula building, metadata analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting.
  • Stay current on Salesforce releases, features, and best practices to propose continuous system improvements.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated experience as a Salesforce Administrator in a complex, heavily automated environment. Experience in healthcare, marketing, or agency/managed services environments is a strong plus.
  • Certifications:Salesforce Administrator certification required. Advanced Administrator, Platform App Builder, or Platform Developer I (PDI) strongly preferred.
  • Core Technical Expertise: Deep knowledge of the Salesforce data model, security architecture, and Flow Builder (including HTTP callouts and complex sub-flows).
  • Cloud Knowledge: Hands-on administration experience across both Sales Cloud and Service Cloud (Case management).
  • Integrations: Experience owning third-party and custom integrations, including middleware/iPaaS (e.g., Celigo / integrator.io) and REST/Webhook syncs. Experience with NetSuite or marketing tech stacks is a major advantage.
  • Analytics: Strong proficiency with custom report types, bucket fields, and dashboards; comfort with SaaS metrics (MRR/ARR/churn) preferred.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience.

2. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate for this specific setup fits the "Technical Modernizer" persona:

  1. The Flow Architect: They don't just "know" Flow; they understand architectural patterns (one Flow per object per event, sub-flows, fault paths) and are comfortable deprecating legacy Process Builders without breaking downstream logic.
  2. The Integration Specialist: They aren't intimidated by API error logs, webhook payload mismatches, or Celigo flow errors between Salesforce and NetSuite. They can trace data failures across system boundaries independently.
  3. The AI-Augmented Admin: They actively use AI tools (Claude Code, LLMs) to draft formulas, analyze SOQL/XML metadata, or generate test cases 2–3x faster than traditional manual admins.

Nice-to have Experience (Preferred):
